EVNG 6050.title: Environmental Engineering Seminar
EVNG 6050.description: Seminar topics presented by students, faculty and guest speakers. Students are expected to attend regularly and demonstrate proficiency in presentation in accordance with the program requirements. Graded P or F.
cilos: Acquire a comprehensive set of discipline-specific professional skills and knowledge for their personal growth and career development.
Describe the new development in their field.
Explain their career choice in academic and non-academic fields.

EVNG 6990.title: MPhil Thesis Research
EVNG 6990.description: Master's thesis research supervised by a faculty member.  A successful defense of the thesis leads to the grade Pass.  No course credit is assigned.
cilos: Design, develop and conduct a research proposal in their research area.

EVNG 7990.title: Doctoral Thesis Research
EVNG 7990.description: Original and independent doctoral thesis research.  A successful defense of the thesis leads to the grade Pass.  No course credit is assigned.
cilos: Design, develop and conduct a research proposal in their research area.
